meta.descricao: Official kit of Valejas Atlético Clube. Compulsory player kit, match kit, training wear and accessories. Always collected at the clubhouse.

metaCarrinho.descricao: Review and send your Valejas Atlético Clube kit order. Collection at the clubhouse.

cabecalho.levantamento: Always collected at the clubhouse. We don't deliver to your home.
cabecalho.prazo: Anything not in stock is ordered in, within {semanas} weeks at most.

kit.texto: Everyone who signs up to play gets four items: the home kit, the away kit for when our colours clash with the opponent's, a set for training during the week and the tracksuit.
kit.guardaRedes: Goalkeepers have their own kit, in green. The match kits already include socks. Pick your size once and take the lot in one go; each item can also be bought separately further down.

duvidas.texto: Not sure about sizes? Drop by the clubhouse and try before you order, or <link>get in touch</link>.
duvidas.fornecedor: Kit made by {fornecedor}. Catalogue and prices updated on {data}.

rodape.nota: Always collected at the clubhouse — we don't deliver to your home, so there's no postage. Kit made by {fornecedor}.

jogo.intro: What you wear on match day. The sets come with shirt and shorts; socks are sold separately.

treino.intro: For the weekly graft and for the cold on the touchline.

adepto.intro: For those who come to watch. They can carry a name and number — or a photo of whoever plays in the family.

acessorios.intro: Scarves, backpacks and everything else you take to the sports hall.

catalogo.introTodas: Match kit, training wear, supporters' items and accessories.
catalogo.nada: Nothing matches these filters. Remove one to see the catalogue again.

cartao.semPreco: This item has no fixed price — it depends on the customisation and the quantity. Talk to the club and we'll tell you how much it is.

kit-atleta.descricao: For outfield players: the home kit, the white away kit, the blue training set and the tracksuit. Both match kits come with socks.

kit-guarda-redes.descricao: For whoever goes in goal: the green kit, the navy away kit, the green training set and the tracksuit. Both match kits come with socks.

equipamento-principal.descricao: The club colours: yellow and blue striped shirt, blue shorts and matching socks. Fully sublimated, with this season's sponsors.

equipamento-branco.descricao: The away kit, for when the opponent's colours clash with ours.

equipamento-verde.descricao: Green, so the goalkeeper stands out from everyone else on the pitch.

conjunto-azul.descricao: Blue shirt and yellow shorts, the supplier's standard design. The cheapest set in the catalogue.

conjunto-verde.descricao: Green shirt and black shorts, standard design.

conjunto-branco.descricao: White shirt with the crest and the club name on the back, with navy shorts.

meias-verdes.descricao: Long match socks, green — to match the goalkeeper kit.

fato-treino.descricao: Hooded jacket and trousers, in navy with the club stripes. The official tracksuit.

sweat-capuz.descricao: Navy hoodie with VALEJAS AC on the chest. Just the top, without the trousers.

bermuda.descricao: Navy long shorts, for training or everyday wear.

camisola-adepto-mote.nome: Supporter's shirt «A união faz a força»
camisola-adepto-mote.descricao: Navy, with the club motto ("Unity is strength") on the front and VAC on the back. For the stands, not the pitch.

camisola-adepto-foto.descricao: Sublimated with a photo of whoever plays in the family, plus their name and number. Arrange with the club which photos to use.

sweat-personalizada.descricao: Top with «MÃE DO» ("Mum of") or «PAI DO» ("Dad of") and the player's name. Worn in the stands and recognised from afar.

casaco-california.descricao: College-style jacket, black with white sleeves and the crest on the chest.

cachecol-lema.descricao: Blue and yellow, with VALEJAS AC on one side and «o nosso lema é ganhar, ganhar, ganhar» ("our motto is win, win, win") on the other.

cachecol-personalizado.descricao: With the name and number of whoever wears it, sublimated on both sides.

cachecol-rosa.descricao: Pink version, with VALEJAS AC on both sides.

mochila.descricao: Sublimated backpack with the stripes and the crest, with a pocket for boots.

registada.guarda: Keep this number. It's how the club identifies you.
registada.confirmar: The club will check what it has at the clubhouse and order whatever's missing. We'll email you when it's ready to collect.
registada.dadosPagamento: — the payment details are in the email.

vazio.texto: You haven't picked anything yet. The youth kit and the rest of the kit are in the shop.

carrinho.prazo: Anything at the clubhouse is set aside straight away. Anything missing is ordered from the supplier and your order is ready when it arrives, within {semanas} weeks. We'll let you know by email.

campos.atletaDica: If the order is for a child or another player

sinal.descricao: You secure the order with part of the amount. The rest is paid when you collect at the clubhouse.

total.descricao: All sorted. You just need to drop by the clubhouse to collect.

carrinho.levantamento: Always collected at the clubhouse. We don't deliver to your home.
